summary: Analyzed salad/bowl/wrap menu items across Royal Greens, Limesalt, Yasas, Hanu Poke for items with zero required BOM components and high customization. Found top 10 BYO bowls (Royal Greens leading at 85 ov), zero wrap matches (Naan Bread is required BOM), and brand-specific patterns.
questions: Which BYO items have no required BOM components and the most customization options?
learned: Royal Greens BYO Greens Bowl has 85 option values, most customization-rich
Wrap items fundamentally differ: Naan Bread is a required BOM component unlike bowl packaging
Cook & Chill Pilot bowls use a different option taxonomy (Grain/Main/Greens)
All salad/bowl BYO items have manage_inventory=false BOM (packaging only)
